Brief: Tell me about the Rosetta mission and what it found at comet 67P. — about Surface changes

1. During Rosetta's lifetime, many changes were observed on the comet's surface, particularly when the comet was close to perihelion.
2. These changes included evolving patterns of circular shapes in smooth terrains that at some point grew in size by a few meters per day.
3. A number of collapsing cliffs have also been observed.
4. One notable example in December 2015 was captured by Rosetta's NAVCAM as a bright patch of light shining from the comet.
5. An apparent outburst of the comet was observed on 14 November 2021.
6. According to the researchers, "At the time of the outburst discovery with ZTF, the comet was 1.23 au from the Sun and 0.42 au from the Earth.
7. The comet's last perihelion passage was on 2021 Nov 2.".
